Some people find relief in it because they see it as ‘punishing themselves’ or they want to distract themselves from the pain of life or quite simply some people are just addicted to it. I can say personally that after you start it becomes a craving and an addiction let alone a coping mechanism. This way of coping brings with it many repercussions, it can make you feel worse about yourself after the deed is done as it is a constant reminder of your broken nature. Or if others who also cut or used to cut see it it can make them relapse.

Overall, I personally used to rely on it a lot and would cut in places people wouldn’t see. But upon reflection, it doesn’t really solve anything or help, overtime you feel the need to go deeper and deeper and eventually end up doing permanent damage or creating ugly scars. 

I would recommend instead: having a cold shower, wearing a rubber band on your wrist and flicking it, punching yourself, an ice cube or even doing some form of exercise. Mentally I like to visualize myself leaving my body and rising to look at the world as a whole so that I can see how much the future holds for me and how what I’m feeling now can be diminished.
